name: @streamplace/core
description: Streamplace platform-agnostic core (data layer, providers, i18n, theme tokens, hooks). No React Native or Expo dependencies.

scripts.check: pnpm --filter @streamplace/i18n compile && bash -c 'set -euo pipefail;export OUT=$(mktemp -d); npx tsc -p . --outDir $OUT; rm -rf $OUT'
